input.answer: Average weekly earnings including overtime for all employees, seasonally adjusted, industrial aggregate (excluding unclassified businesses), Canada, were $1,354.55 in August 2026. That is up from $1,347.35 in July 2026, a rise of $7.20 (1354.55 − 1347.35), or 0.5% (7.20 / 1347.35). I read "typical" as the average (mean) weekly earnings, because StatCan publishes an average, not a median, in this table.
